entries.statement: Every Manager is Temporal-hosted: its Temporal layer is generated from its first construction task, before its hand-written code.
Every built Client has a contract, so its flows can be bound and tested.
An agent writes no test code: the binding is a typed record and the subject comes from the generated scenariocompose package.
promptRefs: claude/commands/service-test-plan.md#there are no hooks and no escape hatches

entries.statement: A UI step targets an element of the approved design whose role takes the action.
Every required surface is entered in every use case that an actor uses it in.
promptRefs: claude/commands/system-draft.md#In every use case an actor enters through a call into each required surface

entries.statement: The System has a Client for each delivery surface the mission lists, of exactly that kind.
promptRefs: claude/commands/system-draft.md#decide which Clients the System must have

entries.statement: The composed app boots through its run contract and answers /readyz, the SPA and every generated MCP tool.
promptRefs: claude/commands/frontend-integration.md#boots the composed app through its run contract

entries.statement: Every scenario fails against a null subject: a test that cannot fail is an error, not a pass.

An agent never edits a generated path: the app's edit-scope gate holds every generated path byte-equal to regeneration (EDIT-GENERATED-DRIFT), and the generators' manifest lists exactly what they write.
